73)yang dag sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la/sems bskyed sdom chog/brgyud 'debs/rang gi snying ga'i='di dang 'gugs pa bcas la/dpal chen he ru ka'i=kha sgyur/ska

tei:div.tei:p: yang dag sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la/ sems bskyed sdom chog/ brgyud 'debs/ rang gi snying ga'i= 'di dang 'gugs pa bcas la/ dpal chen he ru ka'i= kha sgyur/ skyabs sems/ yan brgyad/ lha bskyed/ 'bar pa'i klongaḥ gzhung las/ 'og min gsang chen= lam gyi gsalaḥ 'og gi hūm̐ḥ dpal chen badz+ra= gter du gyuraḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ḥ bsnyen/ bsdu ldang*/ cha gsum/ sa chog rgyal tho/ sri mnan/ sgo byang*/ ma traṃ bsgral/ chag chag ru lu brjod bzhin pas lha tshom dbus 'khor brgyad/ mchod brlab/ lha bskyed gong ltar/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pas/ spyan 'dren/ hūm̐ḥ dmigs med= bstod pa mi sdug= tshig bzhi rjes/ bdag med phyogs bral= bsnyen pa/ rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsolaḥ khyed rnams mchod dang sems can donaḥ nangs par dkyil 'khor bri 'tshal bsaḥ thugs kyis dgongs te gnang bar mdzodaḥ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon/ thig tshon bcas/ ༈ rgyan bkod ni/ las byang sbrel lugs gong bzhin/ bzlas pa/ rab gnas bsnyen/ bdag 'jug rab gnas/ rgyan bkod/ gsol ka tshogs bcas/ ༈ dngos gzhi nyin bdun la/ sngon 'gro ngag 'don/ sems bskyed/ las byang gong ltar/ phyi chog mnyam 'don/ bum sgrub/ mchod phreng*/ (74) gsol ka na rag skong bshags/ tshogs/ rdo rje'i thol glu/ bdag 'jug drang lhag gsol bskyang*/ bskul/ chad brtan bro/ mchod bstod/ bshags brtan/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis/ nyul+le bskrad/ byin 'bebs bcas so/ ༈ nyin brgyad par/ las byang*/ gsol ka tshogs/ bskul pa/ dngos grub bsnyen/ bskrad byin dngos grub blang*/ dbang*/ ༈ mchog gi sbyin sreg la/ tshig bdun/ 'dzam gling*/ rdor dril byin rlabs/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ rol/ sman gtor rak+ta'i sngags/ sreg rdzas byin rlabs/ thab byin rlabs/ dz+wa la raṃ/ rol/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rol/ thab kyi me'i= dad pa dang ni= rol/ dzaḥhūṃ= shab+da= rol/ ji ltar= nas/ gsol bar gyur/ ag+ne= lan bdun/

sngags ring rol/ de 'dra lan gsum/ oṃ ag+ne de ba ri ṣi ha bya ka bya de ba= lan bdun/ bdag cag= rol/ de 'dra bcu/ hūm̐ḥ tshangs pa= na moḥ rig pa'i= swa bha ba= hūm̐ḥ me lha'i lte ba= zla gam stengaḥ gzhung gi paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba dngaḥ ma las nyi steng dbang phyug khyo shug bkugaḥ spyan 'dren/ hūm̐ḥ dmigs med mkha' ltar= rol ring*/ rtsa sngags kyis tshom bu thab tu dor/ 'bras bu'i yang dag sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor= sogs nas/ lam gyis gsalaḥ hūm̐ḥ bla med= shab+da 75) zhi rol/ dkyil 'khor= ru lu= sarba= bdag dang = rol/ de 'dra gsum/ ru lu= bcu/ sarba= bdag dang = de 'dra brgya/ lha tshogs= de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swa hā/ rol/ oṃ badz+ra taṃ bu la ye swa hā/ rol/ shab+da/ rol/ gtor ma/ sman raka hūṃḥ mi gnas= bstod/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ.āḥhūṃḥ tshogs rdzas 'dod yon= sogs/ tshogs thab tu 'bul/ dgang blugs nyer gcig rol/ hūm̐ḥ byin rlabs= lha tshogs rnams kyi= sngags sham can nyer gcig ar+ghaṃ= rol/ bdag med phyogs bral= tshig bstod bzhi/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya min gang bgyis pa// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ yig brgya/ lha tshogs rnams sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gshegs par gyur/ rol ring*/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ ag+ne dz+wa la= gcig oṃ ag+ne de ba= rol/ oṃ ag+ne dz+wa la= gcig oṃ ag+ne de ba= rol/ de 'dra bcu/ tam bu= was+t+ra= rol/ shab+da= rol/ gtor ma sman raka sngags/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lhaḥ drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdagaḥ shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas laḥ mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshalaḥ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 76) rnal 'byor= rol/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dngaḥ gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pasaḥ 'dir ni bya min gang bgyis paḥ de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigasaḥ

badz+ra muḥ ye shes= rnam par gyur/ bla ma yi dam= phun sum tshogasapa= khrom dbang*/ drang lhag gsol ka bkyags ba nas/ mchod bstod bshags gsum yan/ oṃ/ khyed kyi= bsdu ldang*/ phyi nang gsang 'tshams bsdu/ mar me'i smon lam/ las byang gi bsngo shis/ bla ma yi dam= phun sum tshogs pa= bkris zhal bskor kyis bde skyid kyi nyi ma lhag par 'bar ro// dge'o//
